title: 第二百八十章 生死与共第二百七十九章 误入重围
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
黑暗如潮，数以千计的蜘蛛魂兽从四面八方向小屋涌来，幽绿的复眼汇成一片死亡的光海。
朱华音面色沉静，白银玄凤笛横在唇边，黑色万年第五魂环亮起——
“第五魂技·凤鸣裂空！”
尖锐的笛声化作无形的声波，如同水面荡漾的涟漪，以她为中心向四周扩散开去。声波所过之处，冲在最前面的蜘蛛魂兽如同被无形的巨锤击中，甲壳瞬间炸裂，八条长腿无力地抽搐，绿色的体液混杂着碎裂的内脏四溅！
仅仅一击，数十只百年蜘蛛魂兽毙命，上百只十年蜘蛛魂兽瘫软在地。
张三看到这一幕，心中稍定。
朱华音的声波攻击范围极大，对这些低级魂兽的杀伤力堪称恐怖。
朱华音仅仅只是随意一击就几乎将音波范围内所有蜘蛛魂兽杀绝。
若只是这些杂兵，即便再来数千甚至上万，恐怕也难逃被音波震杀的命运。
“朱前辈，看来光靠你就能清理掉这些畜生了。”张三低声道，眼神警惕地扫视着四周。
朱华音没有回话，只是微微点头，手中长笛再次奏响。一道道声波如同收割生命的镰刀，在蜘蛛群中扫荡。短短片刻，小屋周围已堆积起厚厚一层蜘蛛尸体，恶臭的腥气弥漫在空气中。
那些没被波及到还打算继续冲锋的蜘蛛魂兽似乎也察觉到了继续冲击毫无意义故而攻势稍缓，只是在安全的外围徘徊，用复眼死死盯着两人。
“走，我们出去。”朱华音收笛，率先走出小屋。张三紧随其后，鬼影迷踪步已蓄势待发。
月光终于挣脱云层，惨淡地照在这片坟冢之间的战场上。
朱华音立于空地中央，白银玄凤笛再次横起，身后七个魂环光芒大盛。她深吸一口气，准备发动更强大的魂技，一举清场——
就在这时。
轰隆隆——
大地突然剧烈震颤！
不是轻微的震动，而是如同地龙翻身般的猛烈摇晃！
地面龟裂，坟冢崩塌，泥土翻涌！

更多的蜘蛛魂兽从裂开的地缝中爬出，但它们并未着急进攻，而是如同朝圣般向两侧退开，让出一条通道。
看到这种架势，两人心中都充斥着不祥的预感。
果然一股远比之前任何蜘蛛都要恐怖的气息，从地底深处升腾而起！
“不好！”朱华音脸色骤变，猛地向后急退，同时一把将张三拉到身后。
在她话音落下的瞬间——
砰！！！
前方二十丈处的地面轰然炸开！
大量泥土石块如暴雨般四溅！
一只庞然巨物从地底冲出，八条擎天巨柱般的长腿深深插入地面，稳住那如同小山般的身躯！
暗紫色的甲壳上布满螺旋状的金色纹路，同时裂纹遍布，那是与云影激战留下的创伤。但最令人心悸的，是那八只磨盘大小的复眼，每一只都燃烧着妖异的血红火焰！
【八万年兽王·血瞳鬼蛛王】
即便身受重创，它的气息依旧强大到令人窒息，远远超越了朱华音这个72级魂圣的层次！
而随着血瞳鬼蛛王的出现，更多强大的气息从地底涌出。一只只体型庞大、甲壳厚重、复眼凶戾的蜘蛛魂兽爬出地面——千年鬼面蛛、万年蚀骨魔蛛、甚至还有几只气息不弱于寻常魂帝乃至魂圣的万年魂兽！
它们不再像那些低级蜘蛛般畏惧声波，反而迎着朱华音再次发动的声波攻击，硬生生冲了上来！
声波撞击在它们的甲壳上，发出刺耳的摩擦声，却只能在上面留下浅浅的白痕，根本无法造成致命伤害！
朱华音的瞳孔骤然收缩。
她很清楚自己的武魂白银玄凤笛擅长大范围清理杂兵，音波攻击对低级魂兽确实有奇效。
但一旦遇到这种皮糙肉厚的精英敌人，她的声波无法短时间穿透其防御直接杀伤对手，那么等到敌人近身她就会陷入极其被动的局面。
毕竟她的攻击力是同级武魂中偏弱的那一档，其功能性远强于伤害能力。
所以乐器类武魂总是被归为辅助系，在大场面辅助对抗千军万马有奇效，但和六翼天使、昊天锤这种单挑、群攻都没有短板的顶级武魂相比还是有很大差距的。

而且朱华音身板较脆，她的武魂无法强化自身，被近身后张三都能成功威胁她，自保能力非常堪忧。
想要让朱华音全力输出，就需要其他人在一旁保护朱华音，给朱华音一个可以专心吹奏杀伤敌人的安全环境。
但眼下面对蜘蛛群，朱华音身边只有比她自己要低几个大境界的张三，朱华音明白她只能靠自己了。
content_en:
Darkness was like a tide, and thousands of spider spirit beasts were pouring towards the hut from all directions, their green compound eyes forming a sea of ​​deathly light.
Zhu Huayin's face was calm, the silver black phoenix flute was placed on his lips, and the black ten-thousand-year fifth soul ring lit up——
"The fifth soul skill: Phoenix Crying in the Sky!"
The sharp flute turned into invisible sound waves, like ripples on the water, spreading out in all directions with her as the center. Wherever the sound wave passed, the spider soul beast rushing at the front seemed to be hit by an invisible giant hammer. Its carapace exploded instantly, its eight long legs twitched feebly, and green body fluids mixed with broken internal organs splashed everywhere!
With just one blow, dozens of hundred-year-old spider soul beasts were killed, and hundreds of ten-year-old spider soul beasts collapsed on the ground.
Zhang San felt calm after seeing this scene.
Zhu Huayin's sonic attack has a huge range, and its lethality against these low-level soul beasts is terrifying.
Zhu Huayin almost killed all the spider soul beasts within the sound wave range with just one casual blow.
If it were just these miscellaneous soldiers, even if there were thousands or even tens of thousands more, they might not be able to escape the fate of being killed by the sonic shock.
"Senior Zhu, it seems you can clean up these beasts alone." Zhang San whispered, his eyes scanning the surroundings warily.
Zhu Huayin didn't reply, just nodded slightly, and played the flute in his hand again. Sound waves were like scythes harvesting life, sweeping through the spider swarm. In just a few moments, a thick layer of spider corpses had accumulated around the hut, and a foul smell filled the air.
Those spider spirit beasts that were not affected and were still planning to charge seemed to realize that continuing to charge was meaningless, so they slowed down their attack a little. They just lingered in the safe periphery, staring at the two people with their compound eyes.
"Let's go out." Zhu Huayin put away his flute and walked out of the hut first. Zhang San followed closely behind, and Guiying Fan Zubu was ready to go.
The moonlight finally broke away from the clouds and shone palely on the battlefield between the tombs.
Zhu Huayin stood in the center of the open space, the silver black phoenix flute was raised again, and the seven soul rings behind him were shining brightly. She took a deep breath and prepared to use more powerful soul skills to clear the area in one fell swoop——
Just then.
Rumble——
The earth suddenly shook violently!
Not a slight vibration, but a violent shaking like an earth dragon turning over!
The ground cracked, tombs collapsed, and the soil surged!
More spider soul beasts crawled out from the cracks in the ground, but they did not rush to attack, but retreated to both sides like pilgrims to make way for a passage.
Seeing this posture, both of them were filled with an ominous premonition.
Sure enough, an aura far more terrifying than any spider before rose up from the depths of the ground!
"Not good!" Zhu Huayin's expression suddenly changed, and he retreated suddenly while pulling Zhang San behind him.
The moment her words fell——
Bang! ! !
The ground twenty feet ahead exploded!
A large amount of mud and rocks splashed like a rainstorm!
A behemoth rushed out from the ground, with eight long legs like Optimus pillars inserted deeply into the ground, stabilizing the body like a hill!
The dark purple carapace is covered with spiral golden lines and cracks, which are the wounds left by the fierce battle with Yunying. But the most heart-stopping thing is the eight compound eyes the size of millstones, each of which is burning with strange blood-red flames!
[Eighty Thousand Years Beast King·Blood Eyed Ghost Spider King]
Even though it was severely injured, its aura was still so powerful that it was suffocating, far beyond the level of Zhu Huayin, a level 72 soul saint!
And with the appearance of the Blood-Eyed Ghost Spider King, more powerful auras emerged from the ground. Spider soul beasts with huge bodies, thick carapace, and ferocious compound eyes crawled out of the ground one after another-thousand-year ghost-faced spiders, ten-thousand-year bone-eating demon spiders, and even a few ten-thousand-year soul beasts whose auras were not weaker than those of ordinary soul emperors or even soul saints!
They were no longer afraid of sound waves like those low-level spiders. Instead, they rushed forward to face Zhu Huayin's renewed sonic attack!
The sound waves hit their carapace, making a harsh friction sound.But it can only leave shallow white marks on it, and cannot cause fatal damage at all!
Zhu Huayin's pupils suddenly shrank.
She knew very well that her martial spirit Silver Black Phoenix Flute was good at clearing out miscellaneous soldiers in a large area, and its sonic attack was indeed miraculous against low-level spirit beasts.
But once she encounters such a thick-skinned elite enemy, her sound waves cannot penetrate its defense in a short time and directly kill the opponent. Then she will fall into an extremely passive situation when the enemy gets close.
After all, her attack power is the weakest among martial arts of the same level, and its functionality is far stronger than its damage ability.
Therefore, musical instrument martial arts are always classified as auxiliary systems. They are very effective in assisting against thousands of troops in big scenes, but there is still a big gap compared with top martial arts such as Seraphim and Clear Sky Hammer, which have no shortcomings in single combat and group attacks.
Moreover, Zhu Huayin's body is fragile, and her martial spirit cannot strengthen herself. Zhang San can successfully threaten her even if she is approached, and her ability to protect herself is very worrying.
If you want Zhu Huayin to perform at full output, you need other people to protect Zhu Huayin and give Zhu Huayin a safe environment where he can concentrate on playing to kill the enemy.
But now facing the spider swarm, Zhu Huayin only had Zhang San, who was a few levels below her, beside her. Zhu Huayin understood that she could only rely on herself.
